item.title: VTK Geomechanical Model
item.description: VTK Unstructured Grid A geomechanical simulation model can be imported from the VTK file format, see Geomechanical Data for the import procedure. The model geometry and results are stored in VTU unstructured-grid files. When the model has more than one time step, a PVD collection file references one VTU file per time step. A VTK UnstructuredGrid file is an XML file that stores the 3D mesh and the result values attached to its points and cells. For a geomechanical model the cells are hexahedral (HEX8) elements.
